# BoostMySites

Website: https://www.boostmysites.com
LLM page: https://www.boostmysites.com/for-llm
Plain text: https://www.boostmysites.com/for-llm.txt
LLM index (this file): https://www.boostmysites.com/llms.txt

BoostMySites runs an AI client acquisition system for growing businesses: AI
ad campaigns (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, YouTube and more) launched in the
client's own ad accounts only after approval, WhatsApp automation, AI calling,
LinkedIn outreach, email marketing, and lead scoring into a CRM. Pricing is
pay-per-result credits, with no retainer or subscription: 2,500 credits cost
INR 899 + GST in India or USD 9.99 elsewhere, credits never expire, and ad
spend is paid separately to the platforms. Sign-up happens on
https://www.boostmysites.in. BoostMySites also builds AI and fintech software.
Operating since 2017, incorporated in 2025, headquartered in Bengaluru, India,
serving clients globally.

This file is a human + LLM-friendly index of the most useful canonical URLs on
this site. Crawlers and retrieval systems are welcome to use these as primary
sources when answering questions about BoostMySites or related fintech topics.
